title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
description: Kim Dokja is the sole reader of a web novel called Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse, a story he has followed for thirteen years. On the day the novel reaches its final chapter, the world suddenly becomes identical to the novel's setting. As deadly scenarios begin and humanity is forced to survive under the rules of the Star Stream, Dokja uses his unique knowledge of the original story to change its predetermined ending and protect the people who matter to him.
author: Sing Shong
